definitions.explanation: The cost or bill for gas usage, typically for cooking and heating in homes.

examples.japanese: ガス{代|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ガス{代|だい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}かった→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The gas bill was high this month.

examples.japanese: IH⟦コンロ→コンロ：04677_konro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えたら→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ガス{代|だい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かからなく→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After switching to an IH stove, I no longer have gas charges.

notes:
ガス{代|だい} is one of the common utility costs in Japan.

RELATED UTILITY BILLS:
- ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧: electricity bill
- ⟦{水道代|すいどうだい}→水道代：09544_suidoudai⟧: water bill
- ガス{代|だい}: gas bill
- ⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧: utility costs (collective term)

GAS TYPES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{都市|とし}ガス→都市ガス：22713_toshigasu⟧: city gas (piped natural gas)
- プロパンガス/LP⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧: propane gas (tank delivery)

USAGE:
City gas is generally cheaper than propane gas, so ガス{代|だい} can vary significantly depending on the type of gas service available.
